user.title: Merge devices
user.description: Pick two or more devices, in priority order (the first one owns the controls). The next steps let you pair entities and choose how each pair is combined.

data.name: Name of the merged device
data.take_over_ids: Take over the first device's entity ids (renames its entities)

pairing.title: Pair entities
pairing.description: For each entity of a later device, choose which entity of an earlier device it is the same as, or keep it on its own. Suggestions are pre-filled.

strategies.title: Combine values
strategies.description: How should each merged value be combined?

entities.title: Other entities
entities.description: Entities that only one device has. Ticked ones are added to the merged device.
